title: Fixed-field pullback agrees with the transported restricted representation
statement: Under the fields, separable-closure, algebraic-closure, fixed-field equivalence, stalk isomorphism, and germ-action hypotheses of primary_inverseImage_restriction, the pullback of M along Spec(Ks^H) -> Spec K is isomorphic to C.inverse applied to the restricted representation R.

source.place: Tags 03QT, 03QW and 04JQ; blueprint lem-sc-primary-inverse-image-restriction, proof paragraph 1

proof.text: Apply the pullback stalk germ-action comparison to the fixed-field inclusion and its geometric point. The scalar tower identifies the composite geometric point with the given point of Spec K. Compose its stalk isomorphism with the given i and the inverse of the natural stalk isomorphism supplied by hC.

For each g in H extend its underlying K-automorphism to Omega. The extension fixes the image of the fixed field, since every element of that field is fixed by g. Apply the commuting square from the comparison lemma to the two endomorphisms conjugate to the representation actions, using hC and haction for their germ formulas. Cancel the stalk isomorphisms to obtain equivariance of the composed additive isomorphism.

Turn the equivariant additive isomorphism into an integer-linear intertwiner. Its underlying function is bijective, hence its morphism of representations is mono and epi and thus an isomorphism in the abelian representation category. Lift this isomorphism to the full subcategory of discrete continuous representations. Compose the unit of C with the inverse functor applied to its inverse to obtain the required sheaf isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: P3: represented-germ comparison, extension fixing the fixed field, equivariant intertwiner, and unit of C; Tags 03QW and 03Q1

theorem primary_fixedField_pullback_iso
    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (M : Sheaf (Spec (.of K)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (R : Rep.DiscreteContinuousRep.{0, u, u + 1} ℤ (Gal(Ks/K)))
    (i : AddCommGrpCat.of R.obj.V ≅
      ((pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).sheafFiber
        (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj M)
    (haction : ∀ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
      (_hτ : (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
        τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω))
      (X : (Spec (.of K)).Etale)
      (x x' : (pointSmallEtale
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).fiber.obj X)
      (_hx : x'.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ x.left)
      (z : M.obj.obj (op X)),
      i.hom (R.obj.ρ g (i.inv ((pointSmallEtale
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).toPresheafFiber X x M.obj z))) =
      (pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).toPresheafFiber
        X x' M.obj z)
    (H : OpenSubgroup (Gal(Ks/K)))
    [FiniteDimensional K (IntermediateField.fixedField H.toSubgroup)]
    (C : PrimaryFixedFieldEquivalence K Ks H)
    (hC : PrimaryFixedFieldComparison K Ks H Ω C)
    : Nonempty ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap K (IntermediateField.fixedField H.toSubgroup))))).obj M ≅
      C.inverse.obj (primaryRestrictedModule K Ks H R))
